{{Quote|Okay Rescue Leader, here's the plan: Our starfighters will supply air cover while you free the prisoners. The Trade Federation has set up a shield gate, blocking our exit route, but I'm pretty sure we can solve that problem with a proton torpedo or two. Once we destroy the gate, proceed down the river fast, we'll be clearing a path in front of you When you reach open sea, head for the Europa Islands where you'll rendezvous with a resistance freighter.|Rhys Dallows|<ref name="SWSF" />}}
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], a group formed mostly of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] joined together against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in an effort to '''raid''' its prison camps on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. The group consisted of [[Rescue Flight]], members of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]], and the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Reti]]. After arriving at the camps, Reti and the Bravo [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] attacked the [[Turret droid|Trade]] [[Trade Federation Patrol Boat|Federation]] [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|defenses]] in the area and destroyed a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield gate]] on the river. This allowed Rescue Flight to retrieve the prisoners from the camps and escape downriver to a nearby sea. The pilots continued to protect the [[Rescue Boat]]s from [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Federation]] [[Trade Federation droid bomber|reinforcements]] as they traveled to the [[Europa Islands]] to rendezvous with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''. The Naboo forces were successful and the ''Mercatan'' was able to leave with the freed prisoners.

==Prelude==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="NEC" /> In their ensuing occupation, the Federation rounded up the local populace and placed the people in prison camps. One of the [[Trade Federation prison camp|camps]] was set up on islands located near a waterfall on the Solleu River. It was that camp that was targeted to be liberated. A plan was formed to have Rescue Flight, led by [[Rescue Leader]], retrieve the imprisoned with [[Rescue Boat]]s and deliver them to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''. [[Rhys Dallows]], as [[Bravo Ten]], would lead Bravos [[Bravo Eight|Eight]] and [[Unidentified N-1 starfighter pilot|Twelve]] along with his friend Reti to provide air support.<ref name="SF12" />

==Rescue==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)}}
The rescuers approached the camps through a cave that led to the bottom of the waterfall. Rhys and the other pilots were the first to emerge from behind the waterfall and were immediately fired upon by [[turret droid]]s. Rhys ordered the Rescue Boats to hold back while the rest of them destroyed the droids. After enough Federation defenses were neutralized, Rescue Leader ordered Rescue Flight to pick up the prisoners at the camps. The Bravo pilots defended the Boats from patrols of [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] and [[Trade Federation Patrol Boat|Patrol Boats]], and also destroyed a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] gate that was blocking Rescue Flight's escape route. While the Rescue Boats finished at the prison camps, the pilots cleared away turret droids in the valley between the camps and a nearby sea to ensure the boats' safety.<ref name="SF12" />

About the time Rescue Flight began moving downstream, [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and a [[Trade Federation Dropship|dropship]] sent by the Trade Federation arrived in the area and headed for the mouth of the river. Bravo Flight engaged the Federation craft and was able to destroy the [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] before it could deploy any [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tanks]]. The Bravo pilots continued to fight with the droid starfighters until all of the droids were defeated. When the Rescue Boats reached the sea, they came under attack from additional Patrol Boats along with a wave of [[Trade Federation droid bomber]]s. Bravo Flight was able to destroy the new attackers. As Rescue Flight approached the Europa Islands, more bombers and Patrol Boats approached to attack both Rescue Flight and the ''Mercatan''. The pilots fended off the last attack, allowing all the civilians from all three Rescue Boats to be moved to the freighter. ''Mercatan'' then took off under escort from Bravo Flight.<ref name="SF12" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Raid on the Solleu River is the main focus of "Rescue on the Solleu," the twelfth level of the video game ''Star Wars: Starfighter''. For this level, the player takes the role of Rhys Dallows. Destroying the dropship before it lands and destroying all turret droids and bombers are bonus objectives and are not required to further the story. This article assumes 100% objective completion. If any of the Rescue Boats are destroyed, the mission fails.<ref name="SF12" />
